purpose: One fixed colour temperature per fitting plus the brightness-only control groups, for the public viewer and the controls pack. Not a product schedule.

binding.binding_method: Current master/selection rebind; inherited optical results are not recalculated

status.photometry: generic analytic optics; no manufacturer files; no equivalent-photometry claim for the fixed-white cove strip (720 lm/m generic)

policy: Every fitting has one fixed CCT (2700 K every cove and mood/decorative strip incl. the pooja strip; 3000 K main lights, readers and balcony cylinders; 4000 K task and wet-room lights); no CCT control anywhere; every group has a brightness control; fitting positions and counts are the accepted 104 OPT-1 positions and kitchen option K-2, unchanged.
user_correction: homeowner correction (forwarded): 'fixed' means one non-adjustable CCT per fitting by room and use, not one white for the house; every cove and decorative/mood LED strip is warm white about 2700 K including the pooja strip; every other light has a fixed CCT chosen by room, task and ergonomics; keep product variants low; no CCT controls or tunable hardware

R27-STRIP.applies_to: every cove, flush linear in a LOW lane (LINE), TV-bias and headboard graze strip, pooja strip, bath perimeter / niche / under-vanity strip, balcony plinth, curtain-pocket strips (candidate)
R27-STRIP.reason: user direction: LED strips and coves are warm white 2700 K (mood). Indirect and mood light reads as candle / dimmed-incandescent warmth, stays warm when dimmed, and lights the ceiling and walls rather than a task plane

R27-DECOR.applies_to: dining pendant, pooja pin spot, balcony up-down wall lights, PIR night/step lights
R27-DECOR.reason: visible decorative lamp, or a light used late or at night: warmest, lowest blue content; pooja light is traditionally warm; night routes avoid cool light that wakes people

R30-MAIN.applies_to: main/functional downlights, passage light, art-wall track, readers and balcony cylinders in living, dining, bedrooms, lobby and balcony

R40-TASK.applies_to: kitchen main and worktop task, utility, dressing, bath main/vanity-spot/mirror/face lights, lobby mirror bar, children's study task
